text: Everything built so far lives in tools a DBA opens. This video puts PolicyClaimsDB's own metrics onto a dashboard leadership can check themselves.
Four panels that matter: DTU and vCore utilization, failed connections, and replication lag on the geo-replicated secondary -- the number that matters most before any failover.
None of this needs a new agent. Azure Monitor already emits these metrics -- the work is writing the right KQL query and setting thresholds tuned to this workload, not standing up new infrastructure.
Alert rules page the DBA on-call when utilization or replication lag crosses a sustained threshold, and the workbook is pinned to a shared dashboard leadership can open anytime.
The database is now visible without a report request. Next: taking the whole finished build into the room with leadership.
